sourceRights: Historical source derived from ESPN research; redistribution terms not established. Only calculated player-level aggregates and grouped context published.

methodology.singleFormat: Era-adjusted quality, same-innings team carry, best rolling 25 innings and JAWS-inspired career/7-best-calendar-season surplus
methodology.jaws: JAWS-like = (career standardized contextual surplus + sum of seven highest observed season surpluses)/2. NOT baseball WAR and not adjusted for annual match opportunities.
methodology.combined: Equal-weight arithmetic mean of within-format percentile rankings for each qualifying player. Never compare raw format surplus units directly.
methodology.eligibility: Must meet minimum observed innings in every included format. Does not impute unplayed formats; pre-T20I stars absent from all-three ranking.
methodology.careerScoring: Longevity inherently rewarded. Short peak versus long career is shown separately.
methodology.dataCaveat: Historical source completeness, competition diversity, batting order and measured pitch remain unverified.
